title: Integral closure of a Noetherian normal domain in a finite separable extension is finite
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] normal domain [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring] with fraction field $K$, and let $L/K$ be a finite field extension [def-pc-field-extension] which is separable algebraic [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension]. Then the integral closure of $R$ in $L$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure] is a finitely generated $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module].
